paper_title: Prometheus 2 An Open Source Language Model Specialized in Evaluating   Other Language Models
caption: When merging models, the influence of relative evaluation on absolute evaluation is greater than the influence of absolute evaluation on relative evaluation. Performance of Direct Assessment (colored in green) and Pairwise Ranking (colored in blue) when altering the value to merge evaluator LMs trained on different formats.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between Direct Assessment Correlation, Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, and Average Performance as a function of the Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking Merging Ratio. The x-axis is labeled "(Direct Assessment : Pairwise Ranking) Merging Ratio" and has a linear scale ranging from 1:9 to 9:1, with tick labels at each ratio. The y-axis is split into two scales: the left y-axis is labeled "Direct Assessment Pearson Correlation" and has a linear scale ranging from 0.500 to 0.675, with tick labels at 0.525 intervals; the right y-axis is labeled "Pairwise Ranking Accuracy" and has a linear scale ranging from 50 to 80, with tick labels at 5 unit intervals. A green line, representing Direct Assessment Correlation, begins at approximately 0.490 at a ratio of 1:9 and increases to approximately 0.630 at a ratio of 4:6, then declines to approximately 0.600 at 9:1. A blue line, representing Pairwise Ranking Accuracy, starts at approximately 79 at a ratio of 1:9, decreases to approximately 53 at a ratio of 9:1, with a noticeable decline between 6:4 and 8:2. A black line, representing Average Performance, begins at approximately 0.580 at a ratio of 1:9, gradually increasing to approximately 0.625 at a ratio of 4:6, and then declining to approximately 0.585 at a ratio of 9:1.
